g.title: TF_WFSUBJECTS
g.text: By ticking this flag, you can choose a page to which the actor who receives this task can navigate. The level of authorization will be the same that would be applied if the user accessed this page outside the workflow or, if specified, the authorization of the Security Profile linked to the workflow role. The access control of this content is limited to show/hide settings, by stage. Use this option, for example, to link a read only page for reporting.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: TF_WFPROCESSES
g.text: This message will be displayed to the end user when trying to launch this process for an entity which is not eligible.
Use this option to specify a custom message to be displayed in the Cancel confirmation pop up.
